messages:
chris-sales: Tom (customer) says POC onboarding stuck: SSO returns 403 and SCIM pushes 401. Can someone triage?
emily-se: Hi Tom, can you paste the SCIM response body and the SAML error?
tom-customer: SCIM: 401 Authorization failed. SAML: 'Issuer not recognized (EntityID mismatch)'. We rotated a secret yesterday.
rita-iam: 401 usually token mismatch. Confirm header: Authorization: Bearer <token-from-admin>. Also check there are no extra quotes. For SAML, what EntityID did you configure?
tom-customer: We have https://console.acme-app/saml as EntityID. Your metadata snippet shows https://poc.redwood.ai/saml/sp.
emily-se: We can add a temporary tenant alias for the old EntityID while you update. I'll request it.
config-bot: Requested per-tenant SP alias add by emily-se. Change ID cfg-101011. Status: pending.
rita-iam: Once you update the token and mapping, SCIM expects either userName or emails[0].value. Many IdPs map email to 'mail' by default; map it to emails[0].value or include userName.
tom-customer: Swapped token and fixed mapping to map email -> emails[0].value. Retried SCIM, now 201 Created for 50 users.
config-bot: cfg-101011 approved and deployed at 2026-03-22T11:12:05Z.
emily-se: After alias deploy, SSO login succeeds for our testers.
chris-sales: Rita, can you send a short paragraph about SCIM token rotation for their security team?
rita-iam: Sent DM: "SCIM tokens are tenant-scoped API tokens provisioned from the Redwood Admin console. Tokens can be rotated at any time; rotation immediately revokes prior tokens. Token usage is logged and audit events are available on request."
chris-sales: Great. Follow-ups: emily to update POC ticket, tom to finish user validation, and sales to collect Dedicated pool requirements if they convert. Closing thread.
